description_en: Queries the statistics on advanced mitigation sessions of an Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance
description_zh: 查询DDoS高防（非中国内地）服务的高级防护次数统计数据
name: DescribeDefenseCountStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

DefenseCountStatistics.description_en: The statistics on the number of advanced mitigation sessions
DefenseCountStatistics.description_zh: 高级防护次数统计数据

DefenseCountTotalUsageOfCurrentMonth.description_en: The number of advanced mitigation sessions that are used within the current calendar month
DefenseCountTotalUsageOfCurrentMonth.description_zh: 当前自然月已使用的高级防护总次数（包含实例自带的高级防护和高级防护资源包提供的高级防护）

FlowPackCountRemain.description_en: The number of available global advanced mitigation sessions for the Insurance mitigation plan
FlowPackCountRemain.description_zh: 高级防护资源包中剩余可用的保险版高级防护次数

MaxUsableDefenseCountCurrentMonth.description_en: The maximum number of advanced mitigation sessions available for the current calendar month. The advanced mitigation sessions include the advanced mitigation sessions that are provided free of charge and the global advanced mitigation sessions that you purchase
MaxUsableDefenseCountCurrentMonth.description_zh: 当前自然月可使用的高级防护次数（包含实例自带的高级防护和高级防护资源包提供的高级防护）的上限

SecHighSpeedCountRemain.description_en: The number of available global advanced mitigation sessions for the Secure Chinese Mainland Acceleration (Sec-CMA) mitigation plan
SecHighSpeedCountRemain.description_zh: 高级防护资源包中剩余可用的安全加速线路高级防护次数
